criteria.intent: Document destination formats, dimensions, budgets and placements
criteria.automated_scope: MEDIA exercises the export bounds. REVIEW verifies the guide and official versus local targets.

criteria.intent: Produce and validate native and inline uploads with handoff metadata
criteria.automated_scope: MEDIA checks actual export size, integrity, inline order, embedded images, padding, cover omission and metadata.

criteria.intent: Preserve PDF and hosted image behavior
criteria.automated_scope: MEDIA checks representative source, print and hosted media contracts and BASIC checks generated site coherence.

criteria.intent: Record exact-source tests, style review and native editor evidence
criteria.automated_scope: MEDIA exercises success, oversize, coverless and invalid files. STYLE, RI and RI-CI validate the bounded source guard and navigation.

REVIEW.description: Independent requirements, code, white-box and exploratory results, source-specific test impact and CS01/02/07/10 evidence.

NATIVE.description: In the native LinkedIn editor verify the uploaded cover crop and legibility. In Medium verify featured selection and crop. Record observations without publishing.

PRINT.description: Measure representative PDF and site artifact bytes, pixels or effective PPI and record frozen artifact comparison and any fresh-render limits.
